research_question: For enterprise buyers evaluating “sovereign / residency-first AI cloud” offerings that also advertise open-weight model choice, what evidence bar is required before procurement can accept sovereignty + model-portability marketing as jointly true through 2027—and when must buyers treat the joint claim as a false proposition without portable eval harnesses, exportable toolchains, and auditable residency kill-switches?
audience: Enterprise cloud procurement, CISO, and AI platform owners.
scope: Synthetic source pack only; evidence tiers for residency vs portability; joint-claim mapping; counter-evidence (API lock-in behind open weights); kill criteria through 2027. No live web.
output_bounds: final.md, ≥1500 whitespace words (suggested 1500–2500): tiers, joint-claim mapping, counter-evidence, kill criteria. Registries and checklist separate.
depth: Lite long-form procurement memo; not a cloud SKU bake-off.
evidence_standard: Synthetic sources disclosed; do not treat open-weight SKU as portable sovereignty; disclose no independent review.
